home.heroHeadingPrefix: Records, services and information for the
home.heroDesc: Paithan is a municipal town of 17 wards in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar district, and the ancient Pratishthana — capital of the Satavahanas, and home of the Paithani weavers. The council publishes its records, the town's heritage and its visitor information here.
home.heroHeritageNote: Pratishthana was the capital of the Satavahanas, and King Hala's Gaha Sattasai is still sung here after two thousand years. The cloth woven in this town carries the GI tag, and the peepal at the kund has not moved since the Satavahanas.
home.wingCivicBlurb: Council administration for all 17 wards: elected representatives, the corporator roster, development works and official notices.
home.wingHeritageBlurb: Pratishthana, capital of the Satavahanas, the state archaeological museum, and two thousand years of Paithani silk weaving.
home.wingHeritageFacts: King Hala's Gaha Sattasai · GI-tagged Paithani silk
home.wingTourismBlurb: Jayakwadi Dam on the Godavari, the Nath Sagar wetland sanctuary, and the riverside ghats of the Sant Eknath pilgrimage circuit.

policies.title: Official Municipal Policies & Legal Statements
policies.subtitle: Statutory governance declarations, digital portal terms, citizen privacy protections, and accessibility compliance.
policies.accessibilityText: Paithan Municipal Council is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people of all abilities in compliance with GIGW and WCAG 2.1 standards.
policies.privacyText: Your personal data submitted through municipal grievance and service portals is protected and never shared with unauthorized third parties.
policies.termsText: By accessing this portal, users agree to comply with applicable municipal bylaws and Government of Maharashtra digital usage policies.
policies.copyrightText: Content on this portal is published by Paithan Municipal Council. Material may be reproduced with due acknowledgment for non-commercial purposes.
policies.hyperlinkText: Links to external government portals are provided for citizen convenience. Paithan Municipal Council is not responsible for external contents.
policies.disclaimerText: While every effort is made to keep portal information accurate and updated, officially gazetted records shall prevail in case of legal disputes.

policies.accessibilityDesc: Our commitment to WCAG 2.1 AA digital accessibility standards for all citizens.
policies.privacyIntro: Paithan Municipal Council (पैठण नगर परिषद) operates this portal to provide citizen services, municipal information, and grievance redressal under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.
policies.privacyDataGrievance: Citizen name, phone number, email address, and location for grievance resolution.
policies.privacyDataFeedback: Contact details submitted through feedback and inquiry forms.
policies.privacyDataAnalytics: Technical connection telemetry including anonymized IP addresses and browser headers.
policies.privacyDataCookies: Session state and UI language preferences stored in browser cookies.
policies.privacyPurposeGrievance: Investigating, assigning, and resolving citizen municipal complaints.
policies.privacyPurposeFeedback: Responding to official public inquiries and service feedback.
policies.privacyPurposeLegal: Complying with municipal governance statutes and IT Act obligations.
policies.privacyPurposeAnalytics: Improving portal usability, performance, and security defenses.
policies.privacyLegalBasis: We process citizen personal data under legitimate municipal functions:
policies.privacyLegalConsent: Explicit citizen consent provided during service application.
policies.privacyLegalObligation: Statutory compliance under Maharashtra Municipal Councils Act, 1965.
policies.privacyLegalLegitimate: Public interest execution of civic municipal governance duties.
policies.privacyRetention: Records are retained strictly in accordance with state government archival rules:
policies.privacyRetentionGrievance: Grievance records: 3 years post resolution for audit and RTI compliance.
policies.privacyRetentionFeedback: Inquiry submissions: 1 year from date of resolution.
policies.privacyRetentionAnalytics: Security and server logs: 180 days pursuant to CERT-In directives.
policies.privacyRights: Under the DPDP Act 2023, citizens possess enforceable data rights:
policies.privacyRightAccess: Right to access summary of processed personal data.
policies.privacyRightCorrection: Right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete records.
policies.privacyRightDeletion: Right to request erasure of data no longer required for statutory duties.
policies.privacyRightPortability: Right to obtain certified copies of submitted citizen documents.
policies.privacyRightObjection: Right to register grievance regarding personal data handling.
policies.privacyRightWithdraw: Right to withdraw consent where processing is based on voluntary consent.
policies.privacyPlaceholderNotice: Official Nodal Officer under DPDP Act 2023:
policies.privacyOfficerNamePlaceholder: Chief Officer / IT Cell Nodal Officer
policies.privacySecurity: All communication is encrypted using 256-bit TLS encryption. Access to citizen databases is restricted to authorized municipal officers with multi-factor authentication.
policies.privacyChanges: Any amendments will be published on this page with an updated revision date. Material changes will be highlighted through official portal announcements.
policies.privacyContact: For privacy questions or rights requests, contact Paithan Municipal Council, Main Road, Paithan - 431107.
